title: Notification regarding the full court reference on demise of Laimayum Sharat Sharma, Advocate.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Dated the 6th August, 2026
On 7th August, 2026 at 11:30 a.m., there will be a reference on the demise of
Laimayum Sharat Sharma, Advocate, in Chief Justice’s Court (Court No.1).
BEFORE
HON’BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE M. SUNDAR
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE A. BIMOL SINGH
AND
HON'BLE MR, JUSTICE A. GUNESHWAR SHARMA
Reference by:
1. Mr. Naorem Kurnarjit Singh, President, High Court Bar Association of Manipur.
2. Mr. Kh. Samarjit Singh, Deputy Solicitor General of India.
3. Mr. S. Brajabihari Singh, Chairman, Bar Council of Manipur.
4. Mr. Soraisham Chittaranjan, Addl. Advocate General, Manipur.
Reference by Court:
HON’BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE
(2 MINUTES SILENCE WILL BE OBSERVED)
'*' #Z-(KH. AIIT SINGH)
